notes.title: Introducing Kitsune Tails!
notes.notes:
No, this is not [url=https://store.steampowered.com/app/1293910/Read_Only_Memories_NEURODIVER/]NEURODIVER[/url], which we are still diligently working on, but we’d like to announce a delightful new game featuring classic platforming, magic & queer romance!

[previewyoutube=2XBSBUlc5Es;full][/previewyoutube]
In collaboration with another amazing queer game studio, [url=https://kitsunegames.com/]Kitsune Games[/url], the makers of the game MidBoss (coincidentally named, but not associated with us) and the even more famous [url=https://store.steampowered.com/app/1258040/Super_Bernie_World/]Super Bernie World[/url], we’re proud to announce development of our upcoming title [url=https://kitsunegames.com/kitsunetails/]Kitsune Tails[/url], a platformer styled after beloved classics steeped in Japanese mythology and diverse relationships, coming to PlayStation 5, PlayStation 4, as well as Windows and Linux via [url=https://store.steampowered.com/app/1325260/Kitsune_Tails/]Steam[/url] and itch.io.

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/37943051/4a82bde544214587d619dd74e6db57a81ca4dcbe.gif[/img]

Play as a young female [i]kitsune[/i], one of Inari’s fox-eared and bushy-tailed messengers, and embark on a hero’s journey that begins while delivering your first message. Experience a romantic encounter with a kindly sorceress who comes to your aid in a time of need. Explore the complicated relationship with your former mentor turned antagonist and uncover her reasons for sealing your love interest inside an elemental prison. Unlock powers that manifest as cute outfits to help you run, jump, and dash across five elemental worlds to save your love interest.

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/37943051/e2deaa15275dbd66faa5a531998e60380eb80e05.gif[/img]

[h2]Features[/h2]
[olist]
[*] Classic platforming action set in a land inspired by Japanese mythology
[*] Explore five elemental worlds and various haunted houses
[*] Learn new elemental powers and use them to find secrets and optional story content
[*] Unlock a bonus ending by fully exploring the relationships between characters
[*] Use cute outfits to power up, stomp around by stealing a giant boot from enemies
[*] Defeat your haughty former mentor and her foxy gang of minions
[*] Stomp on pangos to make them curl into a ball, pick them up, and kick them around
[*] Carry lights through haunted houses to reveal secret doors and ward off ghosts
[/olist]

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/37943051/748d370cc053e8610de7a8dd358d1e4e5619af13.gif[/img]

If you like what you see, you can find out more at kitsunetails.com or by visiting the [url=https://store.steampowered.com/app/1325260/Kitsune_Tails/]Steam store page[/url] (wishlist it!), and of course you can always stay up-to-date by following the journey on Twitter.

As always, be sure to keep your augmented eyes [url=https://twitter.com/midboss]on[/url] • [url=https://twitter.com/romadventure]our[/url] • [url=https://www.facebook.com/wearemidboss]social[/url] • [url=https://www.facebook.com/ROMAdventure]media[/url] for further updates!

Until next time!
—MidBoss

notes.title: Read Only Memories: Neurodiver will continue cyberpunk investigations
notes.notes:
We’re headed back to that old cyberpunk future next year in Read Only Memories: Neurodiver, a sequel to 2015’s mystery game 2064: Read Only Memories. We’ll be digging into people’s memories as a telepathic detective with the aid of the eponymous weird critter, the neurodiver, searching for traces of a rogue psychic who’s been wrecking people’s minds in Neo-San Francisco. I’m game. I missed the first game but have heard good things, and cyberpunk psychic detectives are in my top-five types of detectives.

(more…)

notes.title: 2064 INTEGRAL Releases on the Nintendo eShop!
notes.notes:
[h1]Get the Ultimate Edition of 2064![/h1]

[url=https://www.nintendo.com/games/detail/2064-read-only-memories-integral-switch][img]https://steamcdn-a.akamaihd.net/steamcommunity/public/images/clans/9110833/5b94781ac9cd5cf06973c48baace5e86ece04177.png[/img][/url]
 
Howdy Cyberpunks!

As you might already know, 2064: Read Only Memories INTEGRAL went live on the Switch for pre-order a little over two weeks ago.

[url=https://www.nintendo.com/games/detail/2064-read-only-memories-integral-switch][img]https://steamcdn-a.akamaihd.net/steamcommunity/public/images/clans/9110833/2484a05ca4f3b7c0b941a639c133f00e0cff7792.jpg[/img][/url]

We're excited to say that it's now fully [url=https://www.nintendo.com/games/detail/2064-read-only-memories-integral-switch]available on the Nintendo eShop[/url]!
 
That's right, now you can play the coziest and most complete edition of 2064 yet with INTEGRAL. This is the swan song for 2064, bundling in all of the past extras into one neat package and one neat console, the Nintendo Switch!

It's been a long and winding road since the initial release of Read Only Memories back in October of 2015, and it feels right that the end of its journey is with the Switch. Get the best of both worlds playing on a big screen with a cozy couch, on the go in a cozy cafe, half asleep in a cozy bed. As mentioned before, this isn't just the INTEGRAL edition, it's also the (unofficially named) [b]ฅ^•ﻌ•^ฅ COMPLETE 'N' COZY EDITION ฅ^•ﻌ•^ฅ[/b].

It doesn't stop with the main game, though! INTEGRAL also includes a remastered side story, PUNKS, a twine game with a fresh coat of paint to blend in with the world of 2064. Play as Chad & Oliver and discover what they were up to before you meet them in the main game.

Other goodies include:
[list]
[*]Sights of Neo-SF Digital Artbook
[*]Sounds of Neo-SF Soundtrack / Jukebox
[*]Movie Gallery
[*]Main Cast Character Bios
[*]Turing recolor names
[/list]
All accessible through the in-game extras gallery!

So check it out and say farewell to the year 2064 with [url=https://www.nintendo.com/games/detail/2064-read-only-memories-integral-switch]2064: Read Only Memories INTEGRAL[/url].

We hope you'll enjoy it!

===========================================================

[h1]Art Contest Winners[/h1]

Last week we kicked off a fan art contest to build excitement for the launch of 2064 INTEGRAL, and we were blown away! There are two winners – MidBoss Choice vote and the Community Choice vote.

Let's see who won!
 
First up is the MidBoss Choice winner…[b]DOTORIII[/b]

[img]https://steamcdn-a.akamaihd.net/steamcommunity/public/images/clans/9110833/0f3806d3d4fb364e093835744f6be1cd554b9400.gif[/img]

We have an adorable animated Turing, feverishly playing something on their vintage Switch.

Who gave it to them, we wonder?

And our Community Choice winner is… [b]Paku Daoust-Cloutier[/b]

[img]https://steamcdn-a.akamaihd.net/steamcommunity/public/images/clans/9110833/4d8cb4e1cda8c63d08fcb085874f04f521d61876.jpg[/img]

The whole gang is here, featured stylishly in the lettering of 2064, cast on top of a lovely fuchsia and violet Neo-SF cityscape.

Very clever and cool!

Thanks so much to everyone that participated, and congratulations to DOTORIII and Paku!

All of the entries were awesome and really inspired. You can check the others out on our [url=http://wearemidboss.tumblr.com/]blog[/url]! 

And that does it for this week's update. Be sure to swing by the Nintendo eShop and check out [url=https://www.nintendo.com/games/detail/2064-read-only-memories-integral-switch]2064: Read Only Memories INTEGRAL[/url], and big thanks again to everyone who participated in the art contest!

As always, be sure to keep your augmented eyes [url=https://twitter.com/WeAreMidBoss]on[/url] • [url=https://twitter.com/romadventure]our[/url] • [url=https://www.facebook.com/wearemidboss]social[/url] • [url=https://www.facebook.com/ROMAdventure/]media[/url].

See you in Neo-SF, cyberpunks!

- MidBoss

notes.title: Release Dates for Mobile & Nintendo Switch!
notes.notes:
[b]2064: Read Only Memories[/b] might be fresh off its PS Vita and Xbox One releases, but we aren’t done conquering the world yet. Over the next month, our cyberpunk thriller will be coming to iOS/Android mobile devices and Nintendo Switch!

[img]http://cdn.edgecast.steamstatic.com/steamcommunity/public/images/clans/9110833/fd85e7e827f731c5edc0c767ab9b7f3c486ecba9.png[/img]

[i]Read Only Memories: Type-M[/i] will be making its way to the App Store and Google Play on [b]Tuesday March 6th[/b]. This upcoming edition has been specifically re-engineered for mobile devices, with an overhauled interface and a plethora of tweaks that make it rock the small screen. The first chapter will be available for free so everyone can have a taste, but for $5.99 USD you can unlock the rest of the game and experience the full course.

[img]http://cdn.edgecast.steamstatic.com/steamcommunity/public/images/clans/9110833/bcb9a50a44d9c3b13cb0836eceb6f3cf2f46e600.gif[/img]

As an additional treat for iOS users, you will get an awesome iMessage sticker pack, too! 

[img]http://cdn.edgecast.steamstatic.com/steamcommunity/public/images/clans/9110833/b45c76e01ce06dc435c7fc4a85e9e2612db294a0.png[/img]

Finally, [i]2064: Read Only Memories INTEGRAL[/i] lands on the Nintendo Switch on [b]Thursday April 5th[/b]. This definitive edition comes with a ton of additional content, such as:[list]
[*]PUNKS, a fully voice acted side-story exclusive to this version!
[*]The complete soundtrack you can listen to in a dedicated music player!
[*]A deco gallery and a cinema! 
[*]And much more!
[/list]
Best of all, the unique capabilities of the Switch mean you can not only play it anywhere but in any way; Dedicated control schemes allow the game to be played with a single joycon, making it both convenient and accessible! 

If you’re looking for a review copy, email us at rombots@midboss.com and let us know which version you’d like, along with your press credentials.

Thank you so so much for your patience with us as we got these final versions of [i]Read Only Memories[/i] ready -- we really think you’re going to enjoy taking Turing on the go! Stay tuned for more info on [i]2064: Read Only Memories INTEGRAL[/i] in the next few weeks, and get ready for [i]ROM: Type-M[/i] in just 6 days on March 6th!

Until next time, punks.

-Team MidBoss

notes.title: 2064 on Xbox, Read Only Memories Type:M and 2064 for Switch!
notes.notes:
Hey punks of the cyberverse! We have some exciting news, but first, a quick announcement: We’ve been working hard and at last we are ready to deliver the 2064: Read Only Memories experience to Xbox One owners today!


[img]http://cdn.edgecast.steamstatic.com/steamcommunity/public/images/clans/9110833/e1fc12ac3e07581d7769fb1d2b5727616d22241a.gif[/img]
No Xbox One X enchancements though..


Due to an error that will be corrected within 48 hours after launch, the price of 2064 on the Xbox Store will initially be set at $30, which is $10 above the normal price for all other platforms. We’re terribly sorry for the inconvenience and understand if you want to wait to buy until the price is changed to $20, but if you decide to purchase the game while it’s still at $30, e-mail us a receipt and we’ll send you an extra download code for your friend. Thank you for your understanding. 

And now, for some news!


[img]http://cdn.edgecast.steamstatic.com/steamcommunity/public/images/clans/9110833/c6dcbe9134d5ee282acc1c2bbdfdb37cf8077bc9.png[/img]

After many trials and tribulations, we were finally able to make it happen: 2064 will also be releasing for iOS and Android as the long awaited 2064: Read Only Memories Type-M. We know that you have all been waiting patiently for this version to arrive, and while we couldn’t release it at first due to the original deal with OUYA and a few hiccups we hit along the way in getting the game to work on Vita, the time has arrived when Type-M has become a reality. 

To keep the size under 1GB, there will not be any voice acting, however it is a full version of the game that has all the same content as the PC, PS4, and XB1 versions as well as an updated bigger UI. Type-M will be launching in February and will have a free demo with a full unlock price of $6.99.

[img]http://cdn.edgecast.steamstatic.com/steamcommunity/public/images/clans/9110833/7b9c3707b8497f2af17b107789a6b219cd463ebd.gif[/img]


Last, but certainly not least, by the end of March/early April we are launching on Nintendo Switch with an exclusive version titled 2064: Read Only Memories Integral. 

[img]http://cdn.edgecast.steamstatic.com/steamcommunity/public/images/clans/9110833/35bd8735582dfdc0ed879ea4718d8874037bf940.png[/img]

This final version will include a wide variety of new Extras content featuring: a 25 minute sidestory titled PUNKS, the Sights of Neo-SF art book, and the Sounds of Neo-SF soundtrack including extra songs that weren’t on the original soundtrack! Also, we’ve implemented full HD Rumble support for the main game. We hope that you’ll find this to be the ultimate version of 2064!


Thank you for all of your support! We love you all and want you to look forward to future prospects in the Read Only Memories Adventures Franchise. Until then, please continue to follow our social media pages for updates and keep sending us your fanart! 

Hit us up anytime on Twitter at @romadventure or @wearemidboss, or email us at info@midboss.com . 

[img]http://cdn.edgecast.steamstatic.com/steamcommunity/public/images/clans/9110833/d5aff23abe38c74a24c6d3761a18426e9461ff53.png[/img]


Thanks!  

- Team MidBoss

notes.title: Announcing Fast Skip, new VO, and cast member addition!
notes.notes:
Hey punks! We have a couple exciting bits of news for y’all.

First of all, we have added a NEW text skipping feature that allows you to zip through dialog lightning-fast. Just press Ctrl to enable it. We hope this will make replaying the game and checking out new stuff even simpler, as it should be much less of a grind if you want to skip areas or are looking for a specific moment!

As for new content, we are thrilled to add hilarious YouTuber SungWon Cho (ProZD) to the voice cast, who has picked up a few parts across the story.  He’s made an awesome video to announce this [url=https://www.youtube.com/watch?v=yrJ0Oc3FdAM]HERE[/url]!

Also, please enjoy some other new voice files in the game that make the main game now 100% voiced!! There’s a lot from Turing as well as Lexi and Dekker, so if you replay the story you’ll notice a couple essential conversations are now voiced that weren’t before! Yay!

[img]http://cdn.akamai.steamstatic.com/steamcommunity/public/images/clans/9110833/a4d58ff443d87afd340547537306977daf862504.png[/img]

On another note, we’re also proud to bring 2064: Read Only Memories to PS Vita! It’s out now and free for PS4 owners via cross-buy. :) 

Please enjoy!

notes.title: Announcing Our Physical PS4 Release Date with Limited Run and Japanese Release Date with Playism!
notes.notes:
Cyberpunks, we have some really big news for you!

We know many of you have been waiting patiently since we announced it during the week on E3, and the time is finally here: [b]The Limited Run physical edition of 2064: Read Only Memories will be available for sale on Friday![/b]

Our supporters on Patreon got a few previews, but [url=https://limitedrungames.com/collections/games/products/limited-run-105-2064-read-only-memories-ps4]now you can see the three beautiful covers[/url]. They’ll be chosen at random, but [url=https://limitedrungames.com/collections/games/products/limited-run-105-2064-3-pack-ps4]if you’re a super collector like we are Limited Run has put together a bundle so you can get all three covers[/url].

There are only 2,064 copies total of each cover, so getting your order in as quickly as possible. [b]Once they sell out, that’s it![/b]

notes.title: 4 Years since the original KS, and 2 Years since the original Launch! :O
notes.notes:
Hey 'Punks!


It's been almost 4 years since our original Kickstarter ended! We've been working on this game for that long.


We have to start with a huge huge huge thank you. Thank you for believing in us. Thank you for putting your money into a game project from a first time game developer, thank you for believing that we could make this happen, and thank you for entrusting us. A lot has happened in those 4 years! 


We also want to apologize for the lack of communication and poor timeline execution -- we had to learn the hard way about a lot of the pitfalls of making your own game and we greatly overestimated our skill to amount of time ratio, and ended up falling short of a lot of our projections for release dates. This is something we can only promise to work hard on improving for the future, and we hope you'll continue to support us through our growing pains.


We've made a post detailing our present and future plans for 2064: Read Only Memories on our Kickstarter page, which you can read here: https://www.kickstarter.com/projects/gaymercon/read-only-memories-a-tribute-to-90s-adventure-game/posts/2022537


The post details our overall plans for the game and its various ports, here's what you need to know for the Steam version.


- Before the end of November, the game will be released in Japan with full localization (but with English voices)! We have spent a long time working with PLAYISM in Japan to make sure our localization got things right.  We also got to go to TGS to show it off a month ago, and we had a lot of fun showing folks our near completed version of 2064:ROM JP.


We're really glad to have found a partner who understands the vision we had for the game and was committed to making sure it represented the cyberpunk and queer spirit we intended for the world. If you're in Japan or have friends who speak Japanese, please stay tuned. We believe the localization is a true extension of our vision. ːturingː


- Before the end of the year, the game will receive its final, FREE update that includes new voice acting scenes for Dekker, Turing, Lexi, Crow and Gordon, as well as the police ROMs, the hospital ROM and more! The aim was to fill in the major unvoiced gaps, as well a few surprises. It will also include bug fixes and content tweaks.


2064: Read Only Memories will be finally done, closing the book on our game. But worry not - we have begun work on a new Read Only Memories story! We hope you'll stick with us to see what's next, because we are super excited about what we have planned.


Please hit us up anytime at @rom2064 or @wearemidboss on Twitter, or email us at info@midboss.com!! Feel free to share your thoughts on our Steam forums as well! We want to talk to you!

notes.title: Read Only Memories Version 1.1 Is Here!
notes.notes:
[code]Cyberlog: San Francisco, November 2015 A.D.[/code]

[h1]Hey there C-Punks![/h1]

Guess what! [b]ROM 1.1 is HERE![/b] This free update is now live like LIPS! We have a lot of very exciting things to show you, and this is only the first of our planned updates to the Read Only Memories world and lore. Below is our changelog of our major changes, but you may find some additional smaller changes, bug fixes, and tweaks throughout the game.

[list]
[*]Mega Phobetor Arcade is now operational! That’s right, we added a whole new minigame! It even comes with its own achievement! Go to Stardust at any time and play to your heart’s content. [b](Gus and Majid had been a little lazy on the machine upkeep. Also: maintaining arcade machines is really hard.)[/b]

[*]Added additional logic to how drinks and your diet preferences work together, including a brand new drink at the Stardust bar! [b](How long will it take you to find it on the… generous menu?)[/b]

[*]New animations on the monitor in Market Street Ad Screen [b](Does VR kill love? Find out more at 11)[/b]

[*]If TOMCAT respects you, you may be able to get some additional help solving the Login Puzzle, among other minor tweaks.

[*]Over 500 new flavors of Hassy available in game. [b](Follow @hassyholdings for more info)[/b]

[*]Added additional ROMs to opening cutscene.

[*]Parallax to make $50M available to settle lawsuit -- NEO-SF - Parallax (PLLX) said Wednesday that it will make $50 million available to settle a wrongful death of a domestic animal suit, after a faulty ROM caused the death of a family corgi. This was an isolated incident, and can not be considered normal behaviour for a Relationship and Organizational Manager. 

[*]A couple conversations have some pretty drastic changes! If you play through the game again, you might notice some key differences in certain scenes.

[*]Numerous bug fixes and changes for optimal gameplay and plot progression.
[/list]

[h1]“My Read Only Memories Brand Software isn’t showing 1.1!! WHAT DO I DO?!”[/h1]

Don’t fret, it’s simple! Steam users will get the patch queued for download as soon as they open up Steam. Don’t have the internet? ¯\_(ツ)_/¯

If you have a DRM free version, first find whichever platform you purchased on (itch.io, Humble, GOG). itch.io has updated downloads RIGHT NOW and the game will be updated on GoG and Humble soon!

If you’ve got thoughts or questions about the game you’d like to make sure we see, email rombots@midboss.com, post in the Steam Discussion forums, or post on the official MidBoss forums and get in touch with the community! We want our game to be able to grow in a way that works best for our existing user base and makes things easier for those who are coming in. 

Oh by the way! If you’re looking for the hottest way to jan out to the game’s tunes, don’t miss the brand new [url=https://www.youtube.com/watch?v=TVZivJhNgxY]LYRIC VIDEO[/url] to Love Me Better, the game’s official credits theme! Featuring super awesome gamer rapper SAMMUS! She's amazing, check it out.

And while you’re at it, we’ve started our own [url=http://readonlymemories.wikia.com/]wiki for the game[/url] that has been really shaping up lately due to fan contribution!

Thanks again for your support over the last month. It has been astoundingly positive. Please enjoy Read Only Memories 1.1, and stay tuned for details in the future about upcoming patches, updates, and so on.  (-`♡´-) 

Stay Hassy,
The Read Only Memories dev team

notes.title: Impressions: Read Only Memories
notes.notes:
Not being at all expert in Japanese gaming, I m always very self-conscious of my extremely limited vocabulary for the matter. So you ll forgive me when my best comparison for the sort of game we have here with Read Only Memories [official site] is the Phoenix Wright series. A dialogue-led adventure, with point-and-click elements. Conversations scroll and blippity-bloop across the bottom of the screen, occasionally punctuated by daft sound effects and shaking screens. There are probably terms for this.

… [visit site to read more]
